name: Zerg Mission Command
type_line: CONTROLLER — Queue Drain / Refill Battle Rhythm
summary: The swarm drains useful work at its own battle rhythm while Tao sets intent instead of routing tasks.
hyperstition: The swarm drains useful work at its own battle rhythm while Tao sets intent instead of routing tasks.
myth: The songline is the creep's pulse: broods move because the whole hive is singing, not because Tao taps each unit.

engineering.pattern: mission command + reconciliation controller + pull-based worker queue
engineering.origin: military mission command; controller loops; producer-consumer systems
engineering.exemplar: Sigrun Capacity Ledger consuming source-bound queue and capacity plans

checks: does not require worker-to-worker successor spawning
fan-in precedes refill when lifecycle debt exists
deterministic queue/capacity reducers precede neural interpretation
